channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says he is not keen on a deal with Iran as U.S. reportedly prepares for 'massive bombing'
item.description: The U.S. president and his national security team have discussed possibly resuming large-scale U.S. military operations in the coming weeks, NBC News reported.

item.title: Elon Musk blames Indian 'oligarchs' for stalling Starlink launch
item.description: Space X founder Elon Musk accused oligarchs in India of keeping Starlink out of the country to protect their monopoly over consumers.

item.title: America shut out Chinese EVs. Britain welcomed them — and now faces a difficult choice
item.description: Britain faces a finely balanced choice over whether to follow the EU in imposing tariffs on Chinese EVs.

item.title: Stock futures move lower after S&P 500 retreats from record: Live updates
item.description: Stock futures edged lower early Thursday as higher yields dent investor appetite.

item.title: TSMC's September sales jump more than 50% year over year
item.description: TSMC's September net revenue came in at 511.86 billion New Taiwan dollars

item.title: Samsung forecasts record third-quarter profit of $80 billion as AI boom fuels chip demand
item.description: Samsung Electronics reported preliminary third-quarter earnings on Thursday, with operating profit forecast to top 100 trillion won for the first time.

item.title: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
item.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its Sept. 15-16 policy meeting.

item.title: Barclays sees big haircare gains for this consumer stock as shoppers prioritize self-care
item.description: This consumer stock's burgeoning haircare segment is being overlooked despite consumers continuing to splurge on self-care routines, Barclays says.

item.title: Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023
item.description: The Survey of Consumer Expectations indicated that the median outlook for inflation over the next 12 months rose to 3.9%.

item.title: Trump doesn't think Russia plague incident is bioweapon, plans Putin call Wednesday
item.description: Nearly 200 people were placed under medical observation earlier this week in Russia's Irkutsk region in eastern Siberia over suspected exposure to plague.

item.title: The SALT deduction limit is $40,400 for 2026. Here's how to maximize it

item.title: Americans grow more pessimistic about their finances, New York Fed finds — expert warns of ‘tough choices’ ahead
item.description: As affordability pressures mount, Americans are increasingly concerned about their financial future, the New York Fed's data shows.

item.title: Anthropic will be 'most ridiculous IPO' of year, analyst says
item.description: Anthropic reportedly plans to list on the Nasdaq before Thanksgiving, and one bearish advisory firm suggests that investors sit this one out.

item.title: Brazil is having its Argentina moment. How to play it
item.description: Todd Gordon's way to play it is Petrobras (PBR), Brazil's state-controlled integrated oil major.

item.title: Levi Strauss hikes profit guidance after tariff refunds, but its sales outlook is less optimistic
item.description: Levi Strauss on Wednesday posted earnings that beat expectations, though it saw benefits from tariff refunds.

item.title: Consumer stocks have been hammered. Here are some opportunities among the casualties
item.description: Brand name consumer stocks have been in a slump. Wall Street sees opportunity to pick some up at bargain prices.

item.title: Cramer says higher rates are splitting the market in two — and AI stocks have a big advantage
item.description: Jim Cramer said higher borrowing costs are splitting the market, putting pressure on credit-sensitive sectors while AI companies remain largely insulated.

item.title: Supertanker chartered from Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, 10 times higher than pre-war level
item.description: Shipping costs have exploded as the war in the Persian Gulf has led to a shortage of available tankers.

item.title: Trading platform Webull's China ties create national security risk, congressional panel finds; stock drops 18%
item.description: A congressional committee says trading platform Webull is not the ordinary U.S. company it claims, but exposes customer data to Chinese surveillance risk.

item.title: Trump trade chief Greer reports higher cash holdings as law firm pay topped $650K
item.description: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer reported $1.17 million to $3.75 million in assets and disclosed a prior $10,000 payment from Coupang.

item.title: SpaceX’s plans to buy more Nvidia GPUs is keeping Jim Cramer bullish on the chip stock
item.description: SpaceX shows that companies are making a return on their AI compute investments, according to Jim Cramer.

item.title: Airfare is 23% higher than last year. Is now a good time to use points for flights?
item.description: Certain types of award flights don't increase in cost along with the cash price, but that's not always the case.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Food crisis, economic shock ahead as India braces for El Niño

item.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
item.description: The new device shows Microsoft remains committed to making its own PCs even though it's not one of the top device makers.

item.title: Thursday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session

item.title: Trump awarding medals to Musk, Dell, Nadella and other tech execs at science summit
